items.title: ADK ambient expense agent: Pub/Sub-triggered graph with an amount router, an LLM risk review and a human approval pause
items.why: Event-driven expense approval: a Pub/Sub message is parsed and routed by an amount threshold; small amounts are auto-approved; larger ones go to an LLM reviewer that raises a structured alert through a tool, then the run pauses for a manager to approve or reject, and the decision is logged. The google-adk ledger records a defect: a malformed message becomes amount 0 and reaches the auto-approve node, which then indexes a missing key.

tasks.T3: feasible: malformed messages rejected, not auto-approved

oracle.plan: 30 synthetic expense events (fictional), scripted manager decisions. Pass = routing by threshold exact, review alert fields (category, risk flags) correct on >= 80% against frozen labels, approvals and rejections logged, malformed messages flagged (T3).
